I'll treat this as one implementation pass on the same three files: read the frozen correction and the live defects, then fix them without running anything.I'll apply the remaining defects in one pass: memory bounds, civil period resets, join/clock identity, exact numerics, statistics, reuse, and the decisive tests.I'll apply the remaining engine, join, statistics, and test corrections in one pass, starting with overflow-safe geometry and the join/identity clock fixes.The unused legacy string can be removed in chunks because it is only string data, so interior deletions stay valid Python.Deliverable 1 profile/reference draft is corrected in this isolated checkout. Only the three owned files were changed. Tests and imports were not executed here.

## Preserved public APIs

`run_profile_statistics(...)` still returns a **summary dict**. `selected_partition_keys` still accepts encoded list keys. `profile_partition_source_refs(members, role='selected')` and `(neighbors, role='support')` are unchanged. `compute_profile_partition` still returns `(ref, part, measurement)` with geometry/TPO/joins/cells, completeness JSON, `groups` + `paired`, `support_refs`, identity, and consumer hashes. Partition kind and result kind are unchanged.

## What changed

**Memory / history.** `AliasIndex` now stores compact identity records and prunes by the next unit-start watermark, keeping conflicts until that watermark. `IdentityEngine.pending` is an eight-day active atom buffer. Civil state is cells/moments/period-local seen only and resets per period. `future_cache` is released after all 4×3×4 arms for that geometry cut. Statistics pair 14 variants + 6 proxies (and both TPO representations) at one anchor/cut, then drop the wide indexes. `_DateStore.raw` is a typed `array('d')`; raw-value quantiles are kept.

**Civil clocks.** Each variant tracks a real period key. Crossing a boundary emits the previous partial/complete period even if its last day is missing, then resets. `flush_ready` warms out-of-year support without emitting those days; selected year is output ownership only. Future support is consumed and not emitted.

**Completed references.** Baseline `completed_id` is bound only to `source-one-tick-value-7/10`. Developing uses **max** publication `<= cut`. Prior close and PIN069 come from publication-indexed histories with `known_at <=` origin/decision or geometry publication. Fixed anchors are sorted before emit.

**Joins.** Features are the real four formations (no feature `latency_ns`). Each arm uses only the matching formation × latency, so one geometry cut is **48** rows. `actual_known_at_ns` is the profile’s own 250ms publication; scenario is `source_pub - 250ms + arm`, bounded by selection/input. `own_ready` requires eligible complete priced geometry, contract, same stage, feature eligibility, and a mature same-stage label. Owning source identity is resolved by cut and metadata/window bounds. Future frozen-grid `known_at` is max future input known_at; partial future metrics are not eligible-complete.

**Numerics.** Annual/civil moments use Python integers. Rationals that exceed int64 use `*_text` decimal strings and `decode_exact_int`. Side Wasserstein is the 1-Wasserstein between buy/sell CDFs on the same physical ticks (undefined only if a side has no mass). `dominance_margin` is **contracts** (mass), matching the kernel.

**Statistics / reuse.** Named stats now cover SD/percentage bands, weighted quantiles/MAD, TPO IB/tails/single-print counts, POC traverse/terminal-outside, all six future overflow sides plus unpriced/transport. An `intended_link` group spans statuses so no-event rates can be 1/2. Fresh and reuse aggregate the same semantic completeness integers; operational new/reused counts still differ. Reuse authenticates Parquet by hash/size/schema/row-count certificates and does not reread geometry. The markdown report is a complete index plus bound `groups`/`paired` refs.

**Tests (not run).** Corrected 4×3×4=48, zero-latency actual vs scenario, complete feature + incomplete geometry, adjacent-file owning identity, civil week/month/quarter and Dec/Jan disjoint volumes including a missing period-end day, later-data mutation leaving earlier VA/PIN/close unchanged, >int64 numerator roundtrip, nonzero side Wasserstein, every required field has a named unit, mixed no-event intended-link rate, real support neighbor + corrupt-neighbor reject, and fresh/reuse semantic equality. `run_profile_statistics` is no longer unpacked as a tuple. Original kernel fixtures are unchanged.

## Residual limitations (unchanged)

DETAIL/ANCHOR still have no footprint object; the registered kernel is used only after DETAIL auth. There is still no certified venue-complete annual population and no official settlement/open without publication feeds. TPO remains minute-visit / range proxy, not tape dwell. Source known_at is 250ms; 0/250ms/1000ms are counterfactual. Touch/retest order stays unidentified. 1800 CPU / 4 GiB AS and 48000 CPU / 16 GiB physical output remain caps for measured projection after a correct draft — this pass invented no successful measurements.
